en.t: In front of the pond, the summer grass grew thick.

units.source_text: 小径用低矮的栅栏把那块草地划了出来。

en.t: A low fence along the path marked off that patch of grass.

units.source_text: 一个身穿白衬衣的少年横躺在草地上。

en.t: A boy in a white shirt lay stretched out on the grass.

units.source_text: 他身边的矮枫树旁靠着一把竹耙子。

en.t: Beside him, a bamboo rake leaned against a low maple tree.
